hypothesis.mechanism: Time-series momentum on the short side of USD-M perpetuals: when the fast EMA crosses below the slow EMA while price is below its long EMA and both the 7-day and 30-day returns are negative, downtrend persistence (leverage unwinds and forced long liquidations feeding further selling, slow information diffusion, risk-off de-grossing) over the next days to weeks pays more than the round-trip cost plus funding. Short side only; never pooled with or claimed for the long family trend_ema_mom.
hypothesis.regime: any; the rule carries its own per-symbol trend filter (close < EMA200, negative 7d and 30d returns). There is NO BTC regime gate on entry. The PIT regime label used only for reporting and B0 matching is BTCUSDT 4h close vs its trailing EMA200 at the decision time (btc_up / btc_down), identical to trend_ema_mom.v1.
hypothesis.primary_endpoint: sealed forward-holdout episode-clustered mean net R per trade, crypto book, base cost row, short side

universe_rule.label: CURRENT-UNIVERSE / SURVIVOR-BIASED
universe_rule.tiers_rule: Tiers are the list's frozen ranks, fixed before any outcome is viewed. Every metric, baseline and verdict row is reported separately for CORE-10 (ranks 1-10), CORE-20 (ranks 1-20) and EXT-21-40 (ranks 21-40, the extended generalization check), never only pooled; the full-40 book is reported beside them. Each tier is a reporting cut of the same trials: it adds no trial and no adaptive choice.
universe_rule.warm_up: A symbol is decided only once its contiguous closed 4h history inside the opened split reaches the configuration's start index (240 bars max over all configurations, 220 for the primary); a gap restarts the count (never forward-filled). This is the independent warm-up test of plan section 1a; listing age is the universe's own test.
universe_rule.held_positions: A symbol that leaves the universe while held is still read through its View.enter Position capability until covered.
universe_rule.symbol_priority: Within a cycle, exits then entries in ascending frozen-list rank (ties impossible).

deferred_pilot.rule: NOT part of this run: inactive and non-blocking. XAUUSDT / PAXGUSDT identities are recorded only; gold gets its own future preregistration, books and trial budget and cannot hold or block the crypto run. Gold-spot and gold-tokenized are separate books with separate execution / cost rows, reported separately, never pooled with crypto or with each other. Gold does not count toward this crypto trial budget.

rule.entry: se at the close of bar i = cross_down(EMA20, EMA50) and close < EMA200 and ret7d < 0 and ret30d < 0; market SELL (open short) at the open of bar i+1 (taker, adverse slip-v1: fill below the open)
rule.exit_signal: sx at the close of bar i = EMA20 > EMA50 or not (ret7d < 0 and ret30d < 0); market BUY (cover) at the open of bar i+1 (taker, adverse slip-v1: fill above the open)
rule.stop: stop = fill + stop_atr x Wilder ATR14 of the signal bar, CEILED to the tick (rounding can only widen the risk). A bar that OPENS at or above the stop fills at its open (gap, gap slippage row), else a bar whose HIGH reaches the stop fills at the stop (+ adverse slip-v1). Stop checked before anything else on each played bar.
rule.time_cap: PRIMARY (promotable): a lot still open 180 bars after its entry is covered at the open of the next bar (market, taker), served at a split end by the causal View.next_open capability; no next open inside the split = split-end censor (incomplete.split_end, class split_censoring, zb-missing-data/1): INCOMPLETE, never a close, no halt.
rule.exit_times: signal / cap exits and gap stops exit at the bar open; a non-gap intrabar stop exits at the stop-bar CLOSE for the funding window (PR #61 / #67 convention) with the fill at the stop level.
rule.funding: signed actual funding at each actual funding time T with entry <= T < exit time, x funding-mark proxy v1: a SHORT RECEIVES a positive rate and PAYS a negative rate (costs.funding_cost side='short', sign -1). A funding-rate sequence that cannot be proved complete through the played bar (incomplete.funding, class funding_rate_gap, proved per bar from the rows known by then) and a funding event without a mark (incomplete.funding_mark, class funding_mark_gap) are distinct classes; either is an unaccountable event that halts the row (zb-missing-data/1, missing_data).
rule.excursions: MFE / MAE are diagnostics: MFE = entry - lowest low before the exit; on a stop bar the bound is conservative (earlier lows and the stop bar's OPEN, never the stop bar's own low); MAE uses highs, the stop bar bounded by the stop.
rule.indicators: identical to trend_ema_mom.v1 (EMA seeded at the first bar read, adjust=False; Wilder ATR seeded at TR0 = h0 - l0; 7d = 42 bars, 30d = 180 bars on 4h; last 1500 closed bars), plus cross_down(a, b) = a_i < b_i and a_(i-1) >= b_(i-1).
rule.book: Same registered crypto book as trend_ema_mom.v1, run separately on its own equity: 10,000 USDT start, 1% risk of the cycle's wallet snapshot / the ACTUAL per-unit stop risk (stop - fill, with fill = the slipped sell fill rounded DOWN to the tick and stop = ceil_tick(fill + stop_atr x ATR14), exactly as booked), max 4 open lots, gross notional <= 3x equity sized on signal close x 1.10, Cairo-day 3% MTM halt, drawdown kill disarmed; quantity floored to the step, never upsized; min qty / min notional checked on qty x the executable fill; below = counted refusal. A non-finite or non-positive stop risk is refused. Exchange rules: the pinned Binance mainnet snapshot (data/exchange_rules_mainnet.json).
rule.liquidation: PARK-only diagnostic, never an exit (Codex 6112077638). On every played 4h bar t with open shorts: G_t = sum_s q_s x high_s,t; W_t = wallet_t + sum_s q_s x (entry_s - high_s,t), wallet_t = realised wallet after fees and funding booked up to t, every open short marked at its own bar high simultaneously, ignoring stops. Flag the bar when W_t < G_t / 3. Report the flagged-bar count, min_t W_t / G_t and the largest single-bar (high - open) / open of any open short. Any flagged bar = PARK flag; it never changes an exit, fill or sizing. The diagnostic is intentionally more sensitive as gross approaches 3x (G_t / 3 approaches equity); it remains an observation / PARK flag only, never an exit, never a hidden leverage constraint, never a sizing input.
rule.no_maker: No limit orders: every fill is taker.
rule.fill_rounding: after adverse slip-v1: a SELL (short entry) fill is rounded DOWN to the tick; a BUY (cover: signal, cap, stop, gap stop, delist) fill is rounded UP to the tick; the stop level is CEILED to the tick. Risk, sizing, PnL and R use these exact rounded values only.
rule.window: Intentionally identical to trend_ema_mom.v1: a decision is a deterministic function of the last min(1500, contiguous tail) closed bars as read, EMAs seeded at the first bar read, Wilder ATR at its TR, warm-up 220. Accepted only with (1) a gating exact prefix-invariance test: changing / adding / removing any bar before the read window leaves se / sx / stop distance bit-identical; (2) a declared tolerance vs longer history (not a decision rule): seed residual ((n-1)/(n+1))^k, at a full 1500-bar window ~3.1e-7 for EMA200 and ~6.2e-6 for the EMA250 neighbour; on synthetic full-window fixtures prepending 1500 earlier bars changes every indicator by <= 1e-5 relative; real decisions always use the as-read window, never recomputed. (3) Before the window reaches 1500 bars (from warm-up, EMA200 residual ~0.11) decisions depend on the contiguous history start by design, as in STRAT-01. The runner must enforce (1) and (2) in tests.

baselines.B0: 1,000 seeded matched random SHORT entries per candidate trade (seed 20261012): same symbol, side (short), split and PIT regime label (BTC 4h close vs EMA200) at the decision, same hold horizon (the candidate trade's realised bars, capped at 180, exit at the next open), same stop rule (ceiled, gap-at-open), costs, funding sign and universe; drawn from that symbol's eligible decision times in the same split; a draw whose stop or history is invalid is counted invalid. Pairing: episode-paired.
baselines.B1: perp short benchmark (Codex 6112077638): USD-M perpetual short, no spot borrow, signed actual funding (receives positive, pays negative); own book 10,000 USDT per split. Rebalance times tau = every Monday 00:00 UTC in the decision range plus its first bar. M_tau = tier members with a closed 4h bar at tau and a defined ATR14 on the contiguous tail, known at the decision close; a member not listed yet (no bar before tau) is warm-up, not missing. Exact decision window (zb-missing-data/1): a listed tier symbol whose decision candle at tau or exact hole-free T.WINDOW-bar input read behind it has a hole halts the whole row at tau (phase decision); the membership never shrinks or shifts silently. N_tau = |M_tau| (0 = flat). Target q*_s = floor_step((0.01 x E_tau / N_tau) / (2.5 x ATR14_s(tau))), E_tau = B1 MTM equity; if sum(q*_s x close_s(tau) x 1.10) > 3 x E_tau all q*_s are scaled by 3 x E_tau / that sum before flooring; legs below min qty / min notional (qty x fill, mainnet pin) = 0, counted. At the open of the bar starting at tau trade q*_s - q_s (taker, adverse slip-v1); a leaving member is covered. The execution open is required only for a non-zero delta |q*_s - q_s| (a flat member whose target floors to 0 needs none); a decided leg without its open halts the row (phase next_open). No stop, no cap. Funding on held qty at each funding time; a funding-rate or mark gap of a held leg halts the row (funding_rate_gap / funding_mark_gap), never a symbol exclusion. Block R: B1_R(m) = (E_end(m) - E_start(m)) / (0.01 x E_start(m)) at calendar-month boundaries (MTM). Pairing: the candidate's block net R of the same month and split. An INCOMPLETE B1 row is not evidence (fail closed).
baselines.B2: 20-bar momentum short: short when close < close 20 bars earlier, cover when not; same stop, 180-bar cap, costs, sizing and book. Pairing: calendar-month blocks.
baselines.B3: cash (0 R): reduces to the expectancy row.
baselines.p_value: one-sided paired sign-flip permutation test, 10,000 permutations, seed 20261012; Holm-adjusted over the program family (trials.program_multiplicity, n = 35 now); ordinary 95% CIs reported beside it.
baselines.mde: the minimum detectable effect at 80% power for the realised holdout episode count is reported with the family size

edge00.multiplicity: Holm family = every variant, grid point and baseline record of the trend_ema_mom_short AND trend_ema_mom ledgers (n = 35 at freeze)
edge00.pit: the frozen current-list result (labelled CURRENT-UNIVERSE / SURVIVOR-BIASED) passes the expectancy row; PIT-membership reconstruction is a later, non-blocking robustness study (contract section 0.1)
edge00.neighbours: >= 80% of the 12 one-at-a-time neighbours keep the sign of the primary endpoint
edge00.intrabar: unresolved ambiguity <= 5% of trades and no verdict flip (this rule has one stop and no target: every exit bar is single-level BAR, so the ambiguity rate is reported and expected 0)
edge00.e10_drawdown: PARK-only until GOV freezes a ceiling
edge00.e11_follower: 100 / 200 / 500 USDT tiers reported; PARK only a failing tier; RULES-BACKFILLED periods cannot gate it

verdict_rules.development: Any run before the forward holdout opens is development evidence: it can neither PROMOTE nor REJECT. A base-row development mean net R <= 0 is flagged DEV-NEGATIVE for Codex, with no retune either way.
verdict_rules.PROMOTE: only on the sealed forward holdout, per book, for the capped short primary, when every EDGE-00 row passes; INCOMPLETE trades are invalid for promotion and never counted as closed outcomes

REJECT.powered_mean: sealed-holdout sample row met (adequately powered: >= 30 sealed-holdout episodes, the MDE at 80% power reported with the family size) and the sealed-holdout base-row mean net R <= 0

retained_gates.cost: after-cost expectancy is gated on the base cost row; every stress row is reported; a cost row still PROVISIONAL / UNCALIBRATED or SLIP-C-UNFITTED cannot support PROMOTE
retained_gates.drawdown: E10 drawdown stays PARK-only until GOV freezes a ceiling
retained_gates.stability: neighbour (>= 80% keep the sign) and LOSO / LOYO robustness rows stay binding for PROMOTE

REJECT.note: The retained gates are predeclared in addition to the powered-mean REJECT: failing one blocks PROMOTE (PARK) even with a positive mean; none of them can turn a powered mean <= 0 into anything but REJECT.

verdict_rules.PARK: every other failure: sample short, CI includes 0 with a positive mean, any baseline / robustness / neighbour / intrabar / E10 row fails, a cost row still PROVISIONAL or UNCALIBRATED, or a rename gap unresolved. A missing-data INCOMPLETE row or tier (zb-missing-data/1) is not evidence of any kind: its verdict is INCOMPLETE, its computed EDGE rows are INCOMPLETE, and it is sealed for audit with no evidence (missing_data.fail_closed)

stop_condition: The forward holdout window is 2026-10-19T00:00Z -> 2027-10-18T00:00Z (exclusive end, 52 weeks), the first Monday 00:00 UTC that a registration after Codex review can precede. `run_r4.py register` must refuse at or after the holdout start; if registration has not been committed before 2026-10-19T00:00Z this draft is void and a new version with the next Monday is drafted (never a back-dated window). m3_reproduction.reason: no legacy short-side M3 rule exists to reproduce; the harness acceptance for the short side is the synthetic short-symmetry test slice (Evidence lane), not a reproduction

rules.one_pass: One causal pass per book row: no re-run and no symbol exclusion. A later gap never rewrites the historical universe, earlier trades, cash or capacity.
rules.first_unaccountable_event: The first unaccountable event rolls its cycle back and halts the WHOLE row there (status INCOMPLETE, first_unaccountable_ms and last_valid_ms, a row censor with wallet + unrealised == mtm). No later cycle is played; nothing is forward-filled, flat-lined or forced to a mark; no symbol is excluded and the row is never rerun without it.
rules.classes: Distinct primary classes: missing_bar (incomplete.gap: a held symbol without its candle, a valid entry without its next-open candle, a fill without its slippage window), delisting (incomplete.delisted), funding_rate_gap (incomplete.funding), funding_mark_gap (incomplete.funding_mark), split_censoring (incomplete.split_end).
rules.one_primary: Exactly one primary per row, chosen deterministically (shared book: the frozen symbol order; unit book: cycle, then phase bar < exit < next_open/fill < funding < decision, then symbol); every other lot open at the halt is the secondary incomplete.book_halt with primary_ref = <symbol>@<first_unaccountable_ms>. Decisions taken at the halt cycle are rolled back with it and not booked.
rules.delist: With an explicit timestamped notice a held short is covered at the first bar open strictly after the notice (exit.delist, delist_cover) and no entry is taken once the notice is known. With no notice, the end of a held symbol's series is incomplete.delisted: INCOMPLETE, never a fake fill or a last-mark close.
rules.slippage_window: A fill at open bo uses exactly the bars closing at bo - (n-1) x 4h .. bo (TR-SMA14: 15 bars; Wilder: the read window); an older row is never substituted. A hole inside that window is incomplete.gap (phase fill / exit); too little history from the series start stays the causal entry_no_slip_history refusal.
rules.b1_decision: B1 short: a listed tier symbol needs its decision candle at tau and a hole-free T.WINDOW-bar input read behind it, else the row halts at tau (phase decision); the membership never shrinks or shifts. The execution open is required only for a non-zero delta |q*_s - q_s|.
rules.split_end: A lot still open at a split end with no observable next open is censored (incomplete.split_end, split_censoring): INCOMPLETE, no halt, never a close.
rules.flat_gaps: A gap of a FLAT symbol leaves the row COMPLETE only when no later decision, sizing, fill, position or accounting depends on it; signal configurations recompute on the contiguous tail after a hole, which only removes entries the missing bars would have carried.
rules.fail_closed: Every result carries status COMPLETE | INCOMPLETE and the policy id. One predicate (tools/research/missing_data.py check / check_tree) is shared by the runner, the report gate and readiness, and refuses a missing status, INCOMPLETE, or a COMPLETE carrying any incomplete marker. An INCOMPLETE primary, neighbour or baseline row makes its tier INCOMPLETE (verdict INCOMPLETE, EDGE rows INCOMPLETE), sealed for audit with no evidence: it feeds no gate, verdict, promotion or holdout_reveal record.
